name: io.github.tradeparadex/mcp-paradex-py
title: Paradex Trading
description: MCP server for Paradex perp trading. Market data, accounts, orders, positions, and vaults.

environmentVariables.name: PARADEX_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Ethereum private key for your Paradex account (enables trading). Without this, only public market data is accessible.

environmentVariables.name: PARADEX_SIGNER_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: Signer mode: header the server sends each message hash in, for a signing proxy that holds the key. Needs PARADEX_SIGNER_SIGNATURE, PARADEX_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS and PARADEX_ACCOUNT_PUBLIC_KEY, and no private key.

environmentVariables.name: PARADEX_SIGNER_SIGNATURE
environmentVariables.description: Signer mode: placeholder the server sends as the signature, for the signing proxy to replace.

environmentVariables.name: PARADEX_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Paradex account address. Required in signer mode.

environmentVariables.name: PARADEX_ACCOUNT_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Signer mode: public key of the key the signing proxy holds.

environmentVariables.name: HTTPS_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Proxy for Paradex API requests, such as a signing proxy. HTTP_PROXY, ALL_PROXY, NO_PROXY and SSL_CERT_FILE also apply.

environmentVariables.name: PARADEX_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: Paradex environment to connect to. Defaults to 'prod'. Use 'testnet' for testing.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for streamable-http transport. Defaults to 3000.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_STATELESS
environmentVariables.description: Enable stateless HTTP mode for Lambda/serverless deployments. Set to 'true' to enable.
